resolutions.title: The array carrier never reached `orbit-emit-composition`, so the write gate cannot find the records it must check
resolutions.action: Carried the array shape into the capability it never reached. DETECTION now keys on the top-level judgements KEY rather than on formed_against, which after the array resolution sits one level down and could never have been found at the top — and the spec now says WHY the key is the right scope: the engine decides whether to descend before it reads anything inside, which keeps the check cheap and total. Refusals now name the ENTRY INDEX alongside the token, because an array-shaped error without an index cannot be acted on. Reworded all four ordering scenarios to name an entry rather than a bare record, and ADDED a fifth the array shape earns: two entries, one valid and one not, refuses the invalid one by index — a valid entry must not rescue an invalid one, and a merged comparison would have hidden exactly that.
